messages:
mike: Trying to cut release v1.14.0, but deploy-bot paused promotion. CI release-build failed with a lockfile drift error. anyone able to grab logs?

deploy-bot: Promotion paused: release/v1.14.0 -> blocked (CI job release-build #432 failed) :warning:

ci-bot: build step output:
```
> npm ci
npm ERR! Your package-lock.json file was modified by an install. Please commit the updated lockfile or use --no-audit.
error Command failed with exit code 1.
```

ana: ah, saw this earlier on a different branch — someone ran `npm audit fix` on main last night, updated package-lock.json, but we didn't cherry-pick that lockfile into the release branch. so the release job sees a diff and fails the strict lockfile check.

sam: do we know what changed? node version skew could cause lock differences too (16 vs 18).

eli: confirmed it's a transitive dependency bump from `minimatch` via an audit fix. not a node version issue — the lockfile hash legitimately changed.

mike: we can't merge main into release (policy), but we can either 1) commit the updated lockfile to the release branch, or 2) pin the offending dep in package.json and regenerate lockfile. what's the lowest-risk?

sre-oncall: committing the updated package-lock.json to the release branch is safe for this patch; it's a non-code dependency change and will match what main already has. also filing a follow-up to prevent surprise in future. created issue #987 to add a CI check that fails earlier with a clearer message.

ana: agree. create a commit that only updates package-lock.json + checksum, no source changes, then re-run the release build.

mike: pushing a fix commit now (5a9c7b) that updates package-lock.json on release/v1.14.0.

mike: @deploy-bot please re-run promotion after CI.

deploy-bot: Received re-run request: requeueing promotion for release/v1.14.0.

ci-bot: release-build #433 started.

sam: :crossed_fingers:

ci-bot: release-build #433 succeeded. all checks green. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Promotion unpaused: release/v1.14.0 -> queued for promote.

mike: rolling out to prod now. watching metrics/dashboard for any regressions.

ana: please add a short note in the release notes: "Updated package-lock.json to sync transitive security fix from main."

mike: noted, added to release notes.

sre-oncall: follow-up actions: 1) add clearer CI message when lockfile mismatches, 2) consider a bot to auto-suggest lockfile cherry-picks for release branches. filing follow-up PRs.

mike: thanks everyone — unblocked. :tada:
